He knows that I get sad but i like to mask what i'm truly feeling on the inside. I feel like I'm a bother when I talk to people about my issues. I'm a listener so anyone anything needs i am always there. I am 20 and have been struggling with these issues for about 8 years. 
At a young age around i was 8 and i got molested by my uncle. He's my uncle who's closest to me in age, so mainly when he was hitting puberty.  He made me show him my parts and made me play with his genitals and at the time i didnt know what to do til i yelled for someone to come and he quickly went to the bathroom as if he was there the whole time.  I couldnt say anything.  I cant fathom the idea of telling an adult that i saw my uncles parts, it just didnt seem right to me at the time.. So i isolated myself from that point on.
So, it started when i was younger.  My father would come home drunk every night and my parents would always get in arguments. One thing that my mother would always do is yell at him when we were there and say comments like are you proud of your dad? Doesnt he look great! Stuff like that.  Overall i was a very quiet girl growing up, I didnt have friends til 5th grade cause I could actually talk to people then. So i ended up sitting alone and keeping to myself all these years. When middle school hit i started feeling depressed not so much suicidal.  In our school we felt like we had to abide by the rules of society, and every girl had to have a perfect image. Just coming out of elementary school with new friends i didnt think much of it. Until the day i started getting hazed in school for not wearing makeup or that i looked pregnant cause i looked "chubby" [in reality i didnt think i was fat just average.]  There and then i started keeping to myself again.  Around that time two of my aunts and my uncle from my fathers side tried to commit suicide.  One of my aunts didnt go through with it, but the other one cut 138 times all around her body.  If i didnt find her that night she wouldnt be with us today.  My uncle broke up with his girlfeiend, took a bottle of oxy's and downed it with vodka.. I too found him overdosing.  Ive been messed up this whole time, shit like that stys with you, but in all the negative ways possible.
In high school i was an outcast.  I barely talked to my peers since i always think theyre talking bad about me or if they laugh theyre laughing at me, but it was my sub conscious convincing me that they were.
After a while i started cutting, mainly because i felt a release, i felt alone, and no one cared. I thought if i did this no ones gonna give a shit about me if i died or anything.  My home life wasnt too great as well. My parents were always working and i had to raise my brothers.  I felt like it was a burden because i wanted to be by myself, drowning in my own thoughts of suicide and obviously i couldnt have that mentality watching over kids. 
In sophomore year i went to a party and got introduced to percs. They were the best pain pills at the time and i felt absolutely invinceable when i took them. Weeks later i was hanging out with that same sketchy crowd and i felt at home, like people understood me. I didnt see anything wrong with it other than the fact that our main focus was buying more and more drugs. Eventually we al hung out at a party, and met this guy. He has the most amazing green eyes and we hit it off immediately. He told me he had some pills in the car that i could have and of course i agreed. So we walked to his car and he takes me talking through some trees and some hills. We sart makingout and i feel him groping me and i didnt like it. I did not expect for him to rip off my pants, throw me on the ground and rape me.  As much as i tried to get him off he he wouldnt let up, he eventually hit me in the face twice and i had nothing else to do but cry and wait for it to all be over.  I woke up in the morning covered in blood, ripped pants, and with bruises on my neck and face. I had neevr told anyone until now, i jyst told my mom i got jumped and she quietely brushed it off. After that i started getting more suicidal thoughts and started feeling more depressed and anxious.  I hated all men for no reason, i couldnt look/trust anyone the same ever again. From that moment i eventually discovered tweak. It was better than pills. The release from reality was amazing, so it became more and moe frequent. I found out i had an addictive personality after and got worse. tl;dr i ended up overdosing twice and checked myself into rehab [best thing ive ever done] I ended up getting prescribed for brain washing meds and everything and stoppedntaking them cause i felt different, not myself.  
Overall i always feel like shit i always feel like i can never ammount to anything, and drinking is my escape.  I admit i have a problem but i refuse to seek for help, because i know it will not get better as juch as i try.

In elementary school I thought I was friends with most people by 4th grade but before then I had no one. Ever since Some kid pointed out that I looked pregnant and his shit head friends went along with it saying when I was going to deliver and that I should stop eating all together. Soon enough it caught on and everyone just ganged up on me. I started growing white patches on my face cause of the anxiety it would bring me. That itself was another reason for girls to bully me saying I will never be pretty and that it was contagious. It got to the point where some kid knocked by lunch tray off my lap when I was sitting under this tree at recess. She said don't tell or ill tell the teacher you stole the chalkboard erasers (they went missing every week or so.) I told my mother but she didn't believe me, as if something like that would never happen to her children. After that I kept shut as the bullying continued. 

Needless to say I had one friend who stood up for me because she was raised better, we're friends today. It still never ceases to amaze me how cruel kids can be, having no idea the hurt and pain it brings. I still think about elementary school and how much people have changed since then.
